name: wclap-ts
description: WCLAP audio plug-ins on a web page: one, a chain, or several side by side.
author: Charlie Culbert

scripts.heavy: node tools/heavy.ts one && node tools/heavy.ts two
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:lib && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:runtime: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp src/runtime/frame.html dist/ && esbuild src/runtime/worklet.ts src/runtime/worker.ts src/runtime/sw.ts src/runtime/frame.ts src/runtime/thread.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] --sourcemap
scripts.build:lib: esbuild src/index.ts src/core.ts src/worklet-api.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] --sourcemap && esbuild tools/setup.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/setup.js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepare: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:lib
